shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
cat package.json
cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.js node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts 2>&1
sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs
sed -n '1,150p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"ajv\" package-lock.json | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry schema compilation compiles a static schema once across ten executions'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry schema compilation names an explicitly forbidden extra property'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry schema compilation names an explicitly forbidden extra property'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,100p'
rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md|validated by\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
rg -n \"spec anchor|spec.md#|split.*#\" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -50

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '88,118p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,50p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
git commit -m "Report forbidden tool input property paths"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
git status --short --branch'
